Name: Rico_Brief_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Neon Row is leaking. Two crews on the east mouths, cameras still live. Marcus wants a debrief after — he always does. Who do you put on the street?
ChoiceB_Text: Rico and Ray. Hold the corners.

Name: Rico_Brief_Pick
Speaker: Rico
Text: Your table. Keep it to three. Marcus stays in the Hall — he is the debrief, not the street.

Name: Rico_Brief_Ray
Speaker: Rico
Text: Ray already knows the corners. I'll walk with him. You can still swap bodies on the roster.

Name: Rico_Brief_Lena
Speaker: Lena
Text: The alley cameras dump to a clerk on Market. If we cut the lights we lose claim but we lose heat. If we leave them, Marcus will smell it.
ChoiceA_Text: Lena walks. Cut the lights if it comes to it.
ChoiceB_Text: Keep Lena off the street. I'll pick.

Name: Marcus_Win_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: You held the Row. The corners are ours until morning. I don't want the story you tell the Hall. I want names. Who called the shots on the ground?
ChoiceC_Text: I called it from the Hall.

Name: Marcus_Win_Rico
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Rico can carry a street. Cameras still have us. Burn the footage, pay the clerk, or leave them and hope.

Name: Marcus_Win_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared credit keeps them. Cameras still have us. Burn, pay, or leave them.

Name: Marcus_Win_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: They noticed. Loyalty thins when the Hall takes the name. Cameras still have us.

Name: Marcus_Win_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the debrief. Watch the meters. Neon Row will leak if you stop putting bodies on it.

Name: Marcus_Loss_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: We lost the Row. Heat is going to crawl toward the Hall. I still need names. Who do we put on the next walk, and what do we do about the cameras?
ChoiceA_Text: Rico owns the miss. He'll fix it.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Rico
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Rico will remember that. Cameras still have the miss. Burn, pay, or leave them.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Crew
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Shared blame is cheaper than a scapegoat. Cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Loss_Ego
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Owning it from the Hall is rare. They'll give you one more night. Cameras still have the miss.

Name: Marcus_Loss_End
Speaker: Marcus
Text: That's the debrief. The Row is thin. Tick the night and watch control leak — or go take it back.

Name: Rico_Docks_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Warehouse door on the river is ajar. We can take the Docks if the Row isn't on fire. Two bodies minimum.

Name: Rico_Market_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Stalls on the Strip will pay if we reclaim them. Not v0. Don't open this until the Row loop is boring.

Name: Rico_Ward_01
Speaker: Rico
Text: Old Ward is masonry and empty lots. Reclamation work. Not v0.

Name: Event_Vex_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Vex didn't show. Someone sold the Docks route. Loyalty was already thin. They're gone.

Name: Event_Rico_01
Speaker: Marcus
Text: Rico's phone is dead. Hall keys are gone. He left a note: You wanted the name on the door. Keep it.
